card.name: Inside Canadian provincial government text
card.fires_on: Words and digits inside Canadian provincial text, mainly Quebec and Ontario, such as phone numbers, region names, years, and agency or act titles. It fires partway through these phrases, where more Canada-related text is likely next.

card.writes: It suppresses Canada-related words such as Canadian, Alberta, Calgary and RCMP, so the model is less likely to repeat a Canadian term next.
